import random, importlib.util, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
import ref
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sched','/app/submission/scheduler.py')
sched=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(sched)
bad=0
for seed in range(200000):
    random.seed(seed)
    R=random.randint(1,8)
    U=random.randint(R,60)
    # borders strictly increasing R+1, 0..U
    cuts=sorted(random.sample(range(1,U),R-1)) if R>1 else []
    borders=[0]+cuts+[U]
    W=[random.randint(0,50) for _ in range(R)]
    H=[random.randint(0,50) for _ in range(R)]
    Q=random.randint(1,5); L=random.randint(1,4)
    a=sched.controller(list(borders),list(W),list(H),R,Q,L)
    b=ref.controller(list(borders),list(W),list(H),R,Q,L)
    if a!=b:
        print("MISMATCH",seed,borders,W,H,a,b); bad+=1
        if bad>10: break
print("ctrl done bad",bad)
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 fuzz_ctrl.py
